changeSet.author: copilot
changeSet.sql: alter table dokument alter column volltext_tsv drop expression

create function archiv_dokument_volltext_tsv(p_id uuid, p_titel text, p_partner text, p_tags text[], p_volltext text, p_dateiname text) returns tsvector language sql stable parallel safe set search_path from current as $$ select setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, coalesce(p_titel, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, coalesce(p_partner, '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, archiv_tags_text(p_tags)), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, coalesce(( select string_agg(w.name, ' ') from dokument_klassifikation dk join klassifikation_wert w on w.klassifikation = dk.klassifikation and w.code = dk.wert where dk.dokument_id = p_id ), '')), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, coalesce(p_volltext, '')), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, archiv_dateiname_text(p_dateiname)), 'D') $$

create function archiv_dokument_volltext_vorher() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path from current as $$ begin new.volltext_tsv := archiv_dokument_volltext_tsv( new.id, new.titel, new.partner_name, new.tags, new.volltext, new.dateiname); return new; end $$
create trigger dokument_volltext_vorher before insert or update of id, titel, partner_name, tags, volltext, dateiname on dokument for each row execute function archiv_dokument_volltext_vorher()

create function archiv_dokument_klassifikation_volltext_einfuegen() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path from current as $$ begin update dokument d set volltext_tsv = archiv_dokument_volltext_tsv( d.id, d.titel, d.partner_name, d.tags, d.volltext, d.dateiname) where d.id in (select dokument_id from neu); return null; end $$

create trigger dokument_klassifikation_volltext_einfuegen after insert on dokument_klassifikation referencing new table as neu for each statement execute function archiv_dokument_klassifikation_volltext_einfuegen()

create function archiv_dokument_klassifikation_volltext_loeschen() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path from current as $$ begin update dokument d set volltext_tsv = archiv_dokument_volltext_tsv( d.id, d.titel, d.partner_name, d.tags, d.volltext, d.dateiname) where d.id in (select dokument_id from alt); return null; end $$

create trigger dokument_klassifikation_volltext_loeschen after delete on dokument_klassifikation referencing old table as alt for each statement execute function archiv_dokument_klassifikation_volltext_loeschen()

create function archiv_dokument_klassifikation_volltext_aendern() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path from current as $$ begin update dokument d set volltext_tsv = archiv_dokument_volltext_tsv( d.id, d.titel, d.partner_name, d.tags, d.volltext, d.dateiname) where d.id in (select dokument_id from alt union select dokument_id from neu); return null; end $$

create trigger dokument_klassifikation_volltext_aendern after update on dokument_klassifikation referencing old table as alt new table as neu for each statement execute function archiv_dokument_klassifikation_volltext_aendern()

create function archiv_klassifikation_wert_volltext_nachher() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path from current as $$ begin update dokument d set volltext_tsv = archiv_dokument_volltext_tsv( d.id, d.titel, d.partner_name, d.tags, d.volltext, d.dateiname) where exists ( select 1 from dokument_klassifikation dk where dk.dokument_id = d.id and dk.klassifikation = new.klassifikation and dk.wert = new.code ); return null; end $$
create trigger klassifikation_wert_volltext_nachher after update of name on klassifikation_wert for each row execute function archiv_klassifikation_wert_volltext_nachher()
update dokument d set volltext_tsv = archiv_dokument_volltext_tsv(d.id, d.titel, d.partner_name, d.tags, d.volltext, d.dateiname)

rollback.sql: drop trigger if exists klassifikation_wert_volltext_nachher on klassifikation_wert
drop trigger if exists dokument_klassifikation_volltext_einfuegen on dokument_klassifikation
drop trigger if exists dokument_klassifikation_volltext_loeschen on dokument_klassifikation
drop trigger if exists dokument_klassifikation_volltext_aendern on dokument_klassifikation
drop trigger if exists dokument_volltext_vorher on dokument
alter table dokument drop column volltext_tsv

alter table dokument add column volltext_tsv tsvector generated always as ( setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, coalesce(titel, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, coalesce(partner_name, '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, archiv_tags_text(tags)), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, coalesce(volltext, '')), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, archiv_dateiname_text(dateiname)), 'D')) stored
create index dokument_volltext_ix on dokument using gin (volltext_tsv)
create index dokument_volltext_ohne_dateiname_ix on dokument using gin (ts_filter(volltext_tsv, cast('{a,b,c}' as "char"[])))
drop function if exists archiv_dokument_volltext_tsv(uuid, text, text, text[], text, text)
